name: Engineering Marvels from Hell
source:
Instruments of torment like the Iron Maiden and the rack weren’t just invented – they were taught. Humanity has perfected cruelty into a dark craft. But where did this knowledge come from?

Hidden worldwide are branches of one sinister institution, known to few as the School of Art and Pain.

You awaken inside its walls – no memory, no escape, only lessons. Here, pain is tradition. And you are its newest student... or its next masterpiece.

[From [url=https://aak581.itch.io/engineering-marvels-from-hell]Itch.io[/url]]
